marking_tests.basis: Independent judgement: COHERENT. Official row (PDF337) awards B1 '3ln(x–2)²' and 'B 1. ✓ 6 × their (a)' with no www token, so the literal row would give 10/10; the D4 www on B2 is a stricter proposed reading, correctly labelled. It matches the comparable Cambridge general note (9709 m16 PDF2): F.T. covers 'work correctly following on from previously incorrect results'; otherwise 'A and B marks are not given for fortuitously "correct" answers or results obtained from incorrect working', and 'wrong working following a correct form of answer is ignored' (keeps B1). www penalises shown wrong working, not absent working, so 'wrong law loses B2 / missing derivation keeps B2' is the standard www asymmetry. It also makes the score k-invariant: the same 2^2 or k+2 reasoning already loses B2 at k=1 and k=3 through a wrong product.
Row 05 B1✓ '6 × their (a)' independent of row 04; D2-S12
